name: Zhik
verdict: Sydney sailing-apparel company whose shareholders include the private equity group Nightingale Partners and its 2023 crowdfunding investors. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: official supplier of the Black Foils (SailGP team page, fetched 2026-09-30). Zhik Pty Ltd's known shareholders are Nightingale Partners, a Sydney-based private equity group that has backed it since 2013 and led the existing shareholders in the 2023 equity crowdfunding, members of the sailing community and the crowdfunding investors (Inside Small Business, 16 Mar 2023; Marine Business News, 15 Feb 2023). The full share register isn't public; no source names a state or state-fund shareholder, and no court, regulator, UN-body or major-NGO human-rights finding against the company was found.
